cases.title: After PIT and CD the current layer is still BLOCKS, nothing new is on layer 0 or on BLOCKS, the pit is on STORMWATER PIT and the flow arrow on ARROW
cases.plan_item: UX-LYR-01 installed part (daily card D24); the never-recolour half is not built
cases.expected: After SETUP-P8 (PIT at 150000,-80000 and a CD pipe to 170000,-80000) the current layer CLAYER still reads BLOCKS (its value when the drawing opened); none of the new objects is on layer 0 or on BLOCKS; the one new pit block is on STORMWATER PIT; the one new flow arrow (TIM_CVL_ARROW) is on ARROW. The layers of the IL texts, the pipe label and the pipe object are recorded.
cases.why_not_unit: Layer choice and the current-layer restore happen in the live drawing's layer table during real PIT and CD runs.
not_automated: 'An existing layer is never recoloured' is NOT BUILT; the layer table colours are not read.
The pit label layer is covered by N05 (this setup escapes the label prompt, so no label exists here).
